{{Top|leg}}
'''Flight Lieutenant''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] in use by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

Flight Lieutenant was a rank used by the [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Starfighter Corps]]. It ranked above [[Flight officer/Legends|Flight Officer]], and below [[Flight Captain]]. The rank was the equivalent of [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Junior Lieutenant/Legends|Junior Lieutenant]] and [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

Imperial [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Rignik]] held the rank shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. Flight lieutenants like ranks above it command pilots to enforce the Empire with numbers.
